contentItem.title: 四倍矩形与平方恒等式
contentItem.englishTitle: If a straight line be cut at random, four times the rectangle contained by the whole and one of the segments together with the square on the remaining segment is equal to the square described on the whole and the aforesaid segment as on one straight line.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If a straight line be cut at random, four times the rectangle contained by the whole and one of the segments together with the square on the remaining segment is equal to the square described on the whole and the aforesaid segment as on one straight line.
如果一条直线随机切除,则整个和其中一部分的矩形和其余部分的正方形的四倍等于整个描述的正方形,而上述部分则等于一条直线。
一直线任两分之其元线偕初分线矩内直角形四及分馀线上直角方形并与元线偕初分线上直角方形等
一直线任两分之其元线与初分线矩内矩形四及分馀线上正方形并与元线与初分线上正方形等
For let a straight line AB be cut at random at the point C;
将AB线直线任意切开至C点;
I say that four times the rectangle contained by AB, BC together with the square on AC is equal to the square described on AB, BC as on one straight line.
我说,AB和BC的矩形和AC的正方形是4倍,等于AB和BC的正方形,即一条直线。
For let [the straight line] BD be produced in a straight line [with AB], and let BD be made equal to CB; let the square AEFD be described on AD, and let the figure be drawn double.
将BD线以直线延伸[AB],将BD线改为CB;将正方形 AEFD线以AD线标出,将数字翻一番。
Then, since CB is equal to BD, while CB is equal to GK, and BD to KN, therefore GK is also equal to KN.
CB等于BD,CB等于GK,BD等于KN,因此GK等于KN。
For the same reason QR is also equal to RP.
出于同样原因,QR也等于RP。
And, since BC is equal to BD, and GK to KN, therefore CK is also equal to KD, and GR to RN. [[I. 36](/principles/euclid-1-36)]
还有因为BC等于BD和GK至KN项因此,CK也等于KD和GR至RN。 [[I. 36](/principles/euclid-1-36)]

But CK is equal to RN, for they are complements of the parallelogram CP; [[I. 43](/principles/euclid-1-43)] therefore KD is also equal to GR; therefore the four areas DK, CK, GR, RN are equal to one another. Therefore the four are quadruple of CK.
但CK等于RN,因为它们是平行四边形 CP的辅助;因此KD也等于GR;因此,4个区域DK、CK、GR、RN是彼此等同的,因此,4个区域是CK的三倍。 [[I. 43](/principles/euclid-1-43)]
Again, since CB is equal to BD, while BD is equal to BK, that is CG, and CB is equal to GK, that is GQ, therefore CG is also equal to GQ.
同样,CB等于BD,BD等于BK,即CG,CB等于GK,即GQ,因此CG也等于GQ。
And, since CG is equal to GQ, and QR to RP, AG is also equal to MQ, and QL to RF. [[I. 36](/principles/euclid-1-36)]
还有因为CG等于GQ、QR至RP,AG也等于MQ和QL至RF。 [[I. 36](/principles/euclid-1-36)]

But MQ is equal to QL, for they are complements of the parallelogram ML; [[I. 43](/principles/euclid-1-43)] therefore AG is also equal to RF; therefore the four areas AG, MQ, QL, RF are equal to one another. Therefore the four are quadruple of AG. But the four areas CK, KD, GR, RN were proved to be quadruple of CK; therefore the eight areas, which contain the gnomon STU, are quadruple of AK.
但MQ等于QL,因为它们是平行四边形,ML的辅助物;因此,AG区域也等于RF;因此,4个区域AG,MQ,QL,RF区域是彼此等同的,因此,4个区域是AG的四倍,但4个区域CK,KD,GR,RN区域被证明是CK的四倍;因此,8个区域,即曲尺形,STU区域,是AK区域的四倍。 [[I. 43](/principles/euclid-1-43)]
Now, since AK is the rectangle AB, BD, for BK is equal to BD, therefore four times the rectangle AB, BD is quadruple of AK.
现在,AK是矩形 AB,BD,BK等于BD,因此,矩形 AB,BD是AK的四倍。
But the gnomon STU was also proved to be quadruple of AK; therefore four times the rectangle AB, BD is equal to the gnomon STU.
但曲尺形 STU也证明是AK的三倍;因此,矩形 AB的四倍等于曲尺形 STU。（相关点与线段：BD）
Let OH, which is equal to the square on AC, be added to each; therefore four times the rectangle AB, BD together with the square on AC is equal to the gnomon STU and OH.
OH等于AC的正方形,每件,即AC,BD和AC的矩形,4倍于矩形,BD和正方形等于曲尺形,STU和OH。（相关点与线段：AB）
But the gnomon STU and OH are the whole square AEFD, which is described on AD. therefore four times the rectangle AB, BD together with the square on AC is equal to the square on AD
但是,曲尺形 STU和OH是整个正方形 AEFD, 其描述为AD。 因此,矩形 AB、BD和AC是正方形, 相当于AD的正方形。

But BD is equal to BC; therefore four times the rectangle contained by AB, BC together with the square on AC is equal to the square on AD, that is to the square described on AB and BC as on one straight line.
但BD等于BC;因此,AB、BC和AC的矩形加正方形等于AD的正方形,即AB和BC的正方形,即一条直线上的正方形。
Therefore etc. Q. E. D.
因此,等等,证毕。

surfaces.text: 一直线任两分之其元线偕初分线矩内直角形四及分馀线上直角方形并与元线偕初分线上直角方形等解曰甲乙线任分于丙题言元线甲乙偕初分线丙乙矩内直角形四〈不论丙乙为长〉〈分为短分〉及分馀线甲丙上直角方形并与甲乙偕丙乙上直角方形等
一直线任两分之其元线与初分线矩内矩形四及分馀线上正方形并与元线与初分线上正方形等解释如下：甲乙线任分于丙命题说明元线甲乙与初分线丙乙矩内矩形四〈不论丙乙为长〉〈分为短分〉及分馀线甲丙上正方形并与甲乙与丙乙上正方形等

surfaces.text: 注曰以数明之设十数任分之为六为四如前图十六互乘之实四为二百四十及四之羃十六共二百五十六与十六之羃等如后图十四互乘之实四为一百六十及六之羃三十六共一百九十六与十四之羃等
注意：使用数字来说明，第十个数字被分为六等份，等于四。例如，在前面的图中，十六乘以实际的四等于二百四十，而四的平方十六等于二百五十六，等于十六的平方。同样，在下图中十四乘以实际的四等于一百六十，而六的平方部分是三十六，总共是一百九十六，等于十四的平方。
